name: Final results from the Palo Verde Neutrino Oscillation Experiment

summary.plain: The full Palo Verde data set, 350 days at 750 and 890 metres from three reactors, showed no disappearance of antineutrinos. It excluded oscillations of electron antineutrinos into other flavours over the mass range suggested by the atmospheric-neutrino anomaly, in agreement with CHOOZ.
summary.technical: Complete data set (Sept 1998 - July 2000): no evidence for nu_e-bar oscillation; nu_e-bar -> nu_x excluded at 90 % CL for delta m^2 > 1.1e-3 eV^2 at full mixing and sin^2(2 theta) > 0.17 at large delta m^2.

title: Final results from the Palo Verde Neutrino Oscillation Experiment
why_it_matters: With CHOOZ, one of the two long-baseline reactor experiments that showed the atmospheric-neutrino oscillation is not electron-neutrino disappearance and that theta-13 is small.
